messages:
maya: Quick kudos thread — massive thanks to @sam for rescuing the canary deploy and for staying overnight so we didn't wake the whole SRE team :heart: You're a legend.
sam: aw, appreciated! team effort. big thanks to @dina for the triage steps and to @oliver for the rollback script.
dina: barely survived the logs 😅 glad the rollback worked. @jen brought snacks to the war room too 🍪
jen: cookies = morale. also, shoutout to @kevin for the early alert + clear steps in the runbook. saved us a ton of time.
oliver: also adding: that new rollback snippet is in eng-runtime repo now — PR #412. ping me if you want a walkthrough.
kevin: config fix was tiny but noisy. happy it helped. kudos all.
maya: also throwing some kudos emojis :tada: :raised_hands: — team lunch on me Friday? vote 👍 or 👎
sam: 👍
dina: 👍
jen: 👍
oliver: 👎 (working on slides) — but I'll bring donuts?
toast-bot: Congratulations! :tada: You've earned 3 kudos points.
maya: ok plan: Friday 1pm. i'll DM the calendar invite. thanks everyone, really great cross-team hustle.
kevin: <3
jen: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/cheer-teamwork-3oEduSbSGpGaRX2Vri
maya: thread closed — going to bed now. good job team.
